name: HTPADU
recent: HeiTech Padu 近期出现多项股权变动：Zetrix AI 已悉数脱售 16.9% 股权，不再是大股东；同时公司因股价大跌遭交易所发出 UMA 询问，公司表示不知情。此外，公司更换了外部审计师，并有董事在闭门期内外持续增持股份。
notable: Zetrix AI 脱售 HeiTech Padu 全部 16.9% 股权，套现 RM27.5 million，不再是大股东。
HeiTech Padu 在 SBY Partners 辞任后委任新的外部审计师。
副主席 Dato' Sandraruben A/L Neelamagham 在 9 月至 11 月期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 公司因股价大跌遭交易所发出 UMA 询问，公司表示不知悉原因。
Zetrix AI 及董事经理不再是大股东，出现大股东变动。
公司更换外部审计师，原审计师 SBY Partners 辞任。

news.title: HeiTech Padu appoints new external auditor after SBY Partners' resignation
Insider Moves: Ambest Group Bhd, Salutica Bhd, LFE Corp Bhd, Sersol Bhd, Zetrix AI Bhd, Heitech Padu Bhd, Excel Force MSC Bhd
Zetrix AI exits HeiTech Padu after disposing of entire 16.9% stake for RM27.5 mil
Zetrix AI, managing director cease to be HeiTech Padu substantial shareholders
HeiTech Padu says unaware of reason behind sharp share price drop after UMA query
Zetrix AI plunges 50% in heavy trade, top official says no issue at company
HeiTech Padu hit with UMA query after shares down 30% following 2Q profit drop
Zetrix AI denies rumours linking company to ex-minister Saravanan's graft case

recent_en: HeiTech Padu has seen several shareholding changes recently: Zetrix AI has disposed of its entire 16.9% stake and ceased to be a substantial shareholder; the company also received a UMA query from the exchange after a sharp share price drop and said it was unaware of the reason. In addition, the company changed its external auditor, and a director continued to acquire shares both outside and during the closed period.
notable_en: Zetrix AI disposed of its entire 16.9% stake in HeiTech Padu for RM27.5 million and ceased to be a substantial shareholder.
HeiTech Padu appointed a new external auditor following the resignation of SBY Partners.
Deputy Chairman Dato' Sandraruben A/L Neelamagham acquired shares in the company multiple times between September and November.
risks_en: The company received a UMA query from the exchange after a sharp share price drop and said it was unaware of the reason.
Zetrix AI and its managing director ceased to be substantial shareholders, indicating a change in major shareholding.
The company changed its external auditor after the resignation of SBY Partners.
